planets.name: TOI-2267 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2267 A with a 3.5-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-2267 c crosses its star every 3.5 days and is 1.1 times as wide as Earth, found in 2025.
text.introduction: TOI-2267 c transits TOI-2267 A every 3.5 days and is 1.1 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
